rv.q: This remains an enjoyable and harmonic experience. It is so good to have Theo Ubique back.
If you love LIVE entertainment and especially in small intimate spaces this is a top pick for your time.
And once again the duo have brought magic to their audiences.
It’s the perfect show for right now.
Throughout, Theo’s ensemble makes Songs for a New World a show where hope and struggle are equal partners.
All four have powerful voices and terrific range.
I found myself content and satisfied that Songs for a New World, directed by Fred Anzevino, was my first show back.

cn.t: Critics praise this intimate production as the perfect pandemic comeback, with Jason Robert Brown's emotionally resonant score and polished performances creating an immediate connection in Theo Ubique's cabaret space.

vr.q: if you're in the area definitely check out this production
